theorem.name: NominalCommitmentInvariance
theorem.claim: Let C_k be a ContinuationCertificate that validate_continuation accepts at decision epoch k for observation o_k under nominal physics. Suppose the controller (i) advances C_k through realized noninterruptible events via CertificateStore.advance_or_invalidate, (ii) accepts a customer only when a complete updated certificate C_{k+1} validates coverage of all pending accepted and newly accepted obligations, and (iii) otherwise executes a validated fallback certificate. Then, under exact nominal transition dynamics matching FleetSimulator, every accepted obligation retains a feasible completion plan at every subsequent decision epoch until it is completed, rejected under the plant reject rules, or the episode terminates with a validated residual continuation (or is recorded accepted-unfulfilled when residual validation fails at horizon end).
induction_sketch: Base: at the first accept, validate_continuation certifies a full fleet suffix covering pending ∪ newly accepted customers from current/post-action anchors.

Inductive step (physical event): locked travel/service/charge completes exactly as recorded; advance_or_invalidate strips realized visits; revalidation from the new anchors succeeds or the certificate is invalidated and the controller must not claim coverage without a new validated plan.

Inductive step (decision): a candidate is executed only if validate_continuation succeeds with require_new; otherwise the previously validated advanced certificate is executed (fallback), preserving coverage of already accepted obligations.
Accepts never resurrect rejected customers; in-service customers are covered by the ongoing noninterruptible service and are not re-admitted.
what_is_not_claimed: Robustness to energy/travel disturbances or forecast misspecification.
Global multistage optimality of the economic selection rule.
That residual horizon-end probes cannot fail (accepted-unfulfilled may occur).
Novelty of expected-value stochastic rollout by itself.
theorem.certificate_object: ContinuationCertificate: versioned routes, served set, per-vehicle anchors, accepted set, assumptions — a persisted executable continuation, not a metric.

novelty.candidate_contribution: Persistent executable commitment certificates with event-driven advancement under noninterruptible EV actions, hard admission gating, and economic selection among certificate-feasible first actions.

algorithmic_identity_check.interpretation: Closed-loop outcomes differ from stochastic MPC on some cells; differences must be attributed to persistent certificate fallback / selection ties, not assumed a priori novelty.

novelty.vs_m1: M1 is certificate-carrying ALNS without forecast-based economic first-action selection. CC-E-MPC adds scenario EV ranking among counterfactual first actions.
novelty.vs_b1: B1 validates continuations for ALNS proposals but does not score proactive charge/wait/accept counterfactuals under forecasts.

gate.reason: Persistent nominal commitment certificates are plant-valid with a live nonmyopic oracle demonstration; predictive superiority vs B1 remains mixed/thin and often overlaps stochastic MPC. Finish a certificate-centered technical draft — do not redesign another stochastic policy.
